drivers.explanation: Only 701 of 2,500 contracted patients are active (28% forecast attainment), and the account uses only pharmacy fulfillment despite signing for full hub services, so the program is well short of what the manufacturer bought.
Active patients slipped 2.2% over the last 90 days and the portal has only 2 weekly users with no growth, so there is little momentum to offset the gap.
With ARR of $1.15M paid on 2,500 contracted patients but only about 701 active, the manufacturer is likely to question the value at renewal and push for a smaller contract.

tool_input.next_step: Schedule a meeting this week with the manufacturer's brand team to walk through the hub services they bought, and ask Zeller to brief prescribers on the program so enrollment starts moving toward the forecast.
